answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the velvet checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The lantern graph is rebuilt each epoch, and hence the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the vault audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 2 times its size, so a group of 13 keys loses far more than 13 single identities would. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
